description: Update a page type: name, slug, icon, url prefix, allowChildren, or its custom-field schema. Fields you omit keep their current value, EXCEPT `fields`, which replaces the whole schema. Only call after the user confirms.

acceptedTypes.description: For a 'media' field: allowed media kinds (empty = all).

fields.description: For an 'object' field: nested field definitions.

hidden.description: Hide the field from admin forms (still stored on records).

itemFields.description: For a 'list' of objects: nested field definitions.

itemType.description: For a 'list' field: the type of each item.

localized.description: Store this field's value per language: { en: '...', pl: '...' }. Only 'text', 'textarea', 'richText' and 'markdown' may be translatable - a translatable price or sku would corrupt the catalog and is rejected.

multiple.description: For a 'media' field: true = gallery, false = single.

options.description: Choices for a 'select' or 'multiselect' field. Required (non-empty) for those types.

relationTo.description: For a 'relation' field: what it points at - a collection ('pages', 'forms', 'media_assets', 'users', 'model_records') or 'model:<slug>' for the records of one model (slug from list_models). Required for relation fields.

relationType.description: For a 'relation' field: cardinality. 'hasOne' = one linked id, 'hasMany' = a list of ids. If omitted the CMS treats it as 'hasOne'.

fields.description: Replaces the whole custom-field schema. Read the current one with get_page_type first and send it back with your edit applied - fields you omit are dropped, and their values stop being editable on existing pages.

name: update_page_type
